conditions: Nonzero momentum magnitude for a plane-wave component of a free particle in a specified inertial frame; lambda is its spatial phase wavelength. For a wave packet with narrow momentum spread, the central wavelength is an approximation.

evidence: For a plane-wave momentum eigenfunction with wave vector k, applying the momentum operator -i hbar grad gives momentum vector hbar k. Its magnitude is hbar times |k|. Since spatial phase repeats after distance 2 pi/|k|, lambda=2 pi hbar/p=h/p. For a narrow momentum distribution the central wavelength is approximate.
